description: Repo-scale (axum-bookclub): POST /api/clubs/:from_club_id/members/bulk-transfer must validate every member_id belongs to the source club BEFORE transferring any of them (atomic), plus a destination max_members check
prompts: Clubs gain an optional `max_members` field (a non-negative integer, or null/omitted meaning unlimited) - accept it in POST /api/clubs and return it in club responses. Add `POST /api/clubs/:from_club_id/members/bulk-transfer`: body `{"to_club_id": N, "member_ids": [...]}`, moving the given members from the source club to the destination. This spans two clubs and must be atomic in two ways: (1) validate that EVERY member_id in the request currently belongs to the source club BEFORE transferring any of them - if one doesn't, respond 400 and leave every member in their original club, not partially transferred; (2) validate that moving the WHOLE batch into the destination wouldn't push its member count over its max_members, again before transferring anything.

[dependencies]
